

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        





loop {
    

print!("unconditional once");




break;



}







let mut countdown = 2;






while countdown > 0 {
    

print!("{}", countdown);




countdown = countdown - 1;



}









let ready = true;




let mut remaining = 2;







while ready && remaining > 0  {
    

print!("adapter {}", remaining);




remaining = remaining - 1;



}








print!("after conditions");



    
}
